caption: @traderjoes had the prettiest figs the other day, so I turned them into an easy toddler freezer treat! 🍌✨ Ingredients: • 2 fresh figs, sliced (stem removed) • About ¾ banana, sliced (or use a whole banana) • Whole milk Greek yogurt • 1 @onceuponafarm Tractor Wheel, crumbled Directions: 1. Arrange the fig and banana slices on a plate or tray with parchment paper. 2. Spoon whole milk Greek yogurt over the fruit. 3. Sprinkle with crumbled Tractor Wheel pieces. 4. Freeze for a few hours until set. 5. Transfer to an airtight container and store in the freezer. To serve, let thaw for a few minutes before offering to your little one. 💛 A simple snack packed with fruit, protein, healthy fats, and fiber! ✨ Toddler tip: Figs are a great source of fiber, but if your little one is trying them for the first time, start with a small amount. I only gave my toddler 2 fig slices and added more banana slices since too much fiber at once can sometimes upset little tummies.
